instruction: Place an order for everything in my amazon cart and wishlist for my work address.
notes: Single app (amazon) plus supervisor. The order must contain every cart item plus every wish list item, so each wish list product is moved into the cart (amazon.move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart, default quantity moves the whole entry) before a single amazon.place_order with the saved address named 'Work' and any saved payment card. The wish list size is unknown a priori; the problem uses three representative wish list products and one representative cart product (the agent repeats the move action once per wish list entry actually returned). List-returning lookups (show_cart, show_wish_list, show_addresses, show_payment_cards) are modeled with nullary knowledge predicates since universal effects are not allowed. place_order is guarded by (not (order-placed)) and moves also require (not (order-placed)), so all moves must precede the single order and the goal's per-product (in-cart ...) conditions guarantee every wish list product is in that order; (order-placed-to work-address) forces the Work address. Because the per-product/per-address goal literals name problem objects, supervisor-complete-task's precondition uses the nullary summary (order-placed); it is still necessarily last since every other action requires (not (task-completed)). No answer is needed, so complete_task takes no parameters. Addresses are only read, never updated/deleted.
